about.title: About MotoFuel
about.subtitle: Motorcycle Fuel Consumption Data Visualization Platform
about.whatContent: MotoFuel is an open-source motorcycle fuel consumption analysis platform, featuring 1,779 models with over 470,000 real refueling records from XiaoXiong Youhao. We use data visualization to help riders and researchers understand real-world fuel economy across brands, displacements, and vehicle types.
about.sourceContent: All data comes from XiaoXiong Youhao (xiaoxiongyouhao.com), China's largest automotive fuel tracking community. Users log their mileage and fuel amounts at each fill-up, and the platform calculates real consumption. We automatically scrape the latest data weekly.
about.techContent: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 8 + Tailwind CSS v4 + Apache ECharts. Pure frontend, statically deployed on GitHub Pages with no backend.
about.limitationContent: XiaoXiong Youhao publishes basic aggregated statistics without specific time ranges or model year labels. We receive each model's average fuel consumption and sample count — we cannot analyze trends over time or distinguish between model years. More granular analysis (by region, time period, or model year) requires the XiaoXiong Youhao App or contacting the platform for commercial data access. Therefore, this site's data is best used for broad comparisons and general reference, not as a precise basis for purchasing decisions.
about.disclaimerContent: This project is for data exploration and visualization only. Data copyright belongs to XiaoXiong Youhao. For commercial use, please contact the original data platform for authorization.
